_about: Habitat and points of interest written into site.json by pipeline/build_site.py. Coordinates are planetocentric latitude and east longitude in degrees. Every entry names where its coordinates came from. Keys starting with _ are notes and are not copied into site.json. The FIRST THREE science POIs are the demo mission, in walking order.

_sources.ir1: Farley, K. & Stack, K. (2022). Mars 2020 Initial Reports Volume 1, Crater Floor Campaign. NASA PDS, doi:10.17189/68tf-re13
_sources.ir2: Farley, K. & Stack, K. (2023). Mars 2020 Initial Reports Volume 2, Delta Front Campaign. NASA PDS, doi:10.17189/49zd-2k55
_sources.crism: MRO CRISM MTRDR HRL000040FF summary parameters (the science layer of site.json)

habitat.name: HAB-1
habitat._source: Perseverance landing site (Octavia E. Butler Landing). First waypoint in the NASA waypoints file (sol 13, no motion since landing): lat 18.44462715, lon 77.45088572.

pois.name: Séítah outcrop (Brac)
pois.note: Olivine-rich igneous rock altered by water, with carbonate. Perseverance cored samples Salette and Coulettes here (sols 262-271).
pois._source: ir1: coordinates and lithology of the Brac outcrop samples

pois.name: Delta front toe
pois.note: Flat ground at the foot of the delta scarp with a strong clay signature in CRISM orbital data. Not visited by Perseverance.
pois._source: crism: chosen by us as the nearest flat, firm ground to the habitat with science value above 0.6 (0.66 here). No rover photo exists for this spot.

pois.name: Máaz lava rock (Sid)
pois.note: Crater-floor lava rock with minor carbonate from later alteration. Perseverance cored samples Hahonih and Atsah here (sols 371-377).
pois._source: ir1: coordinates and lithology of the Sid rock samples

pois.name: Rochette (Artuby ridge)
pois.note: Crater-floor basalt with iron oxides, sulfate and minor carbonate. Perseverance cored samples Montdenier and Montagnac here (sols 190-196).
pois._source: ir1: coordinates and lithology of the Rochette samples

pois.name: Séítah outcrop (Issole)
pois.note: Olivine-rich igneous rock with carbonate and sulfate. Perseverance cored samples Robine and Malay here (sols 295-337).
pois._source: ir1: coordinates and lithology of the Issole samples

pois.name: Wildcat Ridge (Hawksbill Gap)
pois.note: Delta-front mudstone with sulfate and small amounts of clay minerals. Perseverance cored samples Hazeltop and Bearwallow here (sols 509-516).
pois._source: ir2: coordinates and lithology of the Wildcat Ridge samples

pois.name: Amalik (Cape Nukshak)
pois.note: Delta-front rock with olivine grains altered by water. Perseverance cored samples Shuyak and Mageik here (sols 575-579).
pois._source: ir2: coordinates and lithology of the Amalik samples

pois.name: Hidden Harbor (Yori Pass)
pois.note: Delta-front sandstone with sulfate and small amounts of clay minerals. Perseverance cored sample Kukaklek here (sol 623).
pois._source: ir2: coordinates and lithology of the Hidden Harbor sample
